name: HIWIN R25-10T3-FDI
description: Factory matched ground FDI nut; precision/preload ordered and inspected.

geometryEvidence.summary: Published ground FDI flange double-nut table6.7; exact flange/body fit and bolt interfaces.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Internal Gothic raceways, returns, balls/spacer and actual preload are opaque/unpublished. Central clearing bore only. Source rigidity at10% preload is NOT requested 3% stiffness. C3/3% require actual measured certificates.

specifications.label: Order and acceptance
specifications.value: Factory-matched ground shaft andFDI nut; request C3 /3% dynamic-load preload, factory-approved ends and lead/preload/backlash inspection records. No certificate or delivered preload claimed.

specifications.label: FDI source evidence
specifications.value: HIWIN Europe table6.7 current published nominal values; original maker S99TE22-2009 printed72 drawing supplies flange orientation and six30deg holes.

specifications.label: Current primary source
specifications.value: Current manufacturer download page resolves the supplied2026catalogue; FDI table6.7 dimensions match the chosen interfaces. ArchiveSHA256 is recorded; custom-end/C3/preload delivery still requires factory acceptance.
